ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/grey) and 15% low-intensity (black/dark) pixel distribution across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity region occupying the central and distal portions of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) contiguous banding is mapped along the entirety of the trailing edge. A dense cluster of low-intensity pixels is localized at the fluke-to-peduncle insertion. A secondary high-contrast dark mottling is present on the interior-medial trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Heterogeneous serration frequency. The left lobe displays a low-amplitude, low-frequency edge profile. The right lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, high-frequency jagged variations with significant irregular peaks and deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a low-curvature linear sweep. Right lobe follows a more pronounced convex curve leading to the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly circular, yellowish-brown high-contrast pixel clusters at both distal tips and along the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, unaligned horizontal linear pixel disruptions across the high-intensity medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged trailing edge margins on the right lobe; extensive parasitic colonization at distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark brownish, linear organic filament (macroalgae/debris) is suspended from the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe.
